area: on-chain app bytes, modules/cartridges, packages, agent (onchain-app/**, packages/**, render/**, worlds/**, proof-kernel/**, agent/**, system-manifest.json, PACKAGE-MANIFEST.json, packaging.json, SOURCE-SHA256.json)
summary:
ANIMA v7 stores its entire 7,952,983-byte web application on chain as immutable bytecode: 101 AppChunk data contracts (STOP byte + <=23,000 payload bytes) assembled by 20 OnchainApp/OnchainAppDirectory archives (each verifies SHA-256 in its constructor and pins leaf codehashes) and sealed by one OnchainModuleDirectory (archive schema 3, 'modular-gzip': up to 32 independently versioned feature archives with exact dependency versions; commitment sha256(abi.encode('anima.functional-runtime/1', ...))). A 15,112,663-byte RAILGUN worker is stored gzip-compressed (4,596,329 bytes, 7 shards/200 chunks) behind a ShardedResource, and a 707,014-byte Module Workbench HTML (31 chunks) behind an immutable ModuleWorkbench anchor. All numbers were re-verified from the committed manifests and chunk files (sha256sum matches).

The NFT 'mints a website': ConfluenceRenderer.render() returns data:application/json;base64 whose animation_url is a ~15 KB self-contained loader (ConfluenceLoader.html(), built from web/confluence/chain-loader.mjs + module-loader.mjs and itself stored in an AppChunk) carrying window.AWE_CHAIN_IDENTITY={seed,genome,root,chainId,collection,tokenId,manifest,privacyResource,runtime,sha256,archiveVersion}. On click the loader uses window.ethereum or a user-supplied HTTPS RPC, pins one block, eth_calls moduleAt/dependencyAt/readChunk, verifies every module's stored and expanded SHA-256, the dependency graph (declared deps must equal real cross-group imports), the directory commitment, and then document.write()s the recovered app. No server, no IPFS, no URL. Ownership gating happens inside the recovered app (ConfluenceWallet.connect: assertMintBinding against the page's own identity, eth_requestAccounts, ownerOf/accountOf at one block, 'This wallet does not own the selected NFT.'; assertOwner() re-run before every review with sessionEpoch binding and mode()==0) and in the workbench (RegistryAdapter.context additionally requires account.currentOwner()==ownerOf). Off-chain services use SIWE-style challenges bound to anima:nft:<chain>:<collection>:<tokenId>:epoch:<sessionEpoch>.

Modules/cartridges: packages/modules (@anima/modules 1.0.0, dependency-free 406,475-byte ESM) defines the canonical anima.extension-release/1 manifest (sha256 of canonical JSON), gzip/raw package envelopes (anima.module-files/1), 23,000-byte content-addressed chunk dedup, bounded recovery at a pinned block hash, exact ABI cross-checks, hash-chained installation history validation, unsigned owner-call recipes, deployment plans/journals and reconciliation. Companion contracts: ExtensionReleaseRegistry (permissionless publish, releaseId=keccak256(abi.encode(domain,publisher,ReleaseInput,manifestHash)), exact dependency ids, publish grants nothing), TokenModuleRegistry (only the NFT's own account may stageState/activate/writeState/disable, with expectedRoot+expectedEpoch stale-review protection, atomic code+state activation, append-only root hash chain), ModuleStateStore (append-only per (collection,tokenId,moduleKey) namespace; 32 KiB direct state stored in 1-2 AppChunks so a full snapshot costs 7.7-7.9M gas, under the 16,777,216 EIP-7825 cap), ModuleArchiveFactory, ModuleWorkbench, ChunkedCartridgeRegistry (legacy raw-HTML cartridges as a second ERC-721 whose launch authority follows the parent NFT's current owner/epoch). A live Sepolia deployment of collection+module system (37 txs, tokens 1-3) is recorded on branch codex/deploy-on-testnet-and-mint-3-nfts-pj8cqs.

The other packages are off-chain or optional: packages/communication (RFC 9420 MLS via ts-mls with AAD bound to chain transport coordinates — reusable social layer), packages/crosschain (LayerZero V2 OFT lane), packages/privacy (RAILGUN worker, mainnets only, external POI/Waku), packages/rehearsal-proof (dev-setup Groth16 AMM quote proof), proof-kernel (Rust policy evaluator), agent/* (MCP/A2A facade, exit keepers, Anvil-fork rehearsal, scenario service, SQLite shared-world server with SIWE sign-in, bounded operator + x402 buyer + provider directory client), worlds/* (deterministic game model and client), render/* (single-source C/GLSL optical kernel compiled to a 9.8 KB Wasm and GLSL ES 3).

components.name: AppChunk / OnchainApp / OnchainAppDirectory / OnchainModuleDirectory / ShardedResource (storage primitives)
components.purpose: Immutable SSTORE2-style storage of the application: data contracts (STOP + <=23,000 bytes), <=64-chunk archives verifying SHA-256 at construction, 16x32-chunk directories pinning leaf codehashes, a 32-module versioned directory with dependency versions and a sha256 commitment, and a gzip resource directory for the privacy worker.

OnchainModuleDirectory(Module[] entries, uint256 shellIndex, bytes32 expectedDigest); schemaVersion()=3, moduleCount(), moduleAt(i), dependencyCount(i), dependencyAt(i,d), shellIndex, byteLength, expandedByteLength, contentSha256

ShardedResource(address[] shards, bytes32 compressedSha256, bytes32 contentSha256, uint256 byteLength); shards(i), shardByteLengths(i), shardChunkCounts(i), shardSha256(i), compressedByteLength, totalChunkCount, schemaVersion()=1
design_decisions: "A STOP byte followed by immutable data. Payload stays below EIP-170 runtime limits."
"Immutable, complete HTML/Wasm/shader archive. Not a mutable URL or an IPFS-only pointer. Browsers still execute the recovered code offchain; storage being onchain is not execution."
"SHA-256 leaf digests cannot establish the concatenated digest. This directory pins that expected digest; readers MUST verify the complete recovered bytes before execution."
"Root commitment excludes deployment addresses so identical feature bytes can be reused across editions; every content digest and dependency version is still pinned."
security_invariants: every chunk's first byte is 0x00 and size<=23001
full SHA-256 verified in constructor; directories re-check leaf codehash on every read
32 modules, 64 MiB stored/expanded caps, dependency indices strictly increasing and version-equal
components.reuse_notes: Deployed sizes: OnchainApp 1,027 B, OnchainAppDirectory 2,333 B, OnchainModuleDirectory 1,152 B, ShardedResource 1,244 B. Add CREATE2 content addressing and collapse the three schema generations into one; keep constructor-time hashing and codehash pinning.

Modular-gzip archive (schema 3): per-feature archives versioned by their expanded SHA-256 so unchanged features are reused byte-for-byte across editions; directory commitment excludes addresses; browser verifies that declared dependencies equal actual cross-group imports
Release identity = keccak256(abi.encode(domain, publisher, ABI ReleaseInput, sha256(canonical manifest))) with the manifest stored opaquely and the client re-encoding it to prove ABI/JSON equivalence

Per-NFT installation hash chain (rootOf) plus expectedRoot/expectedEpoch stale-review protection; atomic release+state activation; independent state-namespace catalog so staged-but-never-activated state is recoverable after a lost receipt
32 KiB direct state stored as 1-2 AppChunks inside the state tx to fit the EIP-7825 cap (29.2M -> 7.9M gas)
Cartridge launch authority resolves through ArtifactBinding to the parent NFT's current owner and ownership epoch (owned-by-the-NFT-account sub-apps)
Capability bridge anima.host/1 with HTML cartridges executed in a Worker whose DOM is a proxied #id subset and whose network constructors are deleted
MLS AAD binds every encrypted message to (chainId, contract, group, index, epoch, sender, kind) so on-chain transport cannot be replayed into another room
Deployment plans predict CREATE addresses for both EOA and factory nonces, journals are reconciled from receipts/code, never from saved success labels
Single-source C/GLSL optical kernel compiled to both Wasm and WebGL2 for identity-derived art with tile-exact parity tests

website_delivery: From chain. ConfluenceRenderer.render() returns data:application/json;base64 whose animation_url is a ~15 KB self-contained HTML loader (ConfluenceLoader.html(), stored in an AppChunk) that embeds window.AWE_CHAIN_IDENTITY (seed, genome, root, chainId, collection, tokenId, manifest, privacyResource, runtime archive address, sha256, archiveVersion). On 'Unfold my artifact' it reads the OnchainModuleDirectory (schemaVersion 3, moduleCount, shellIndex, moduleAt, dependencyAt) and every module's OnchainApp/OnchainAppDirectory chunks via eth_call at one pinned block through window.ethereum or a user-entered HTTPS/loopback RPC, verifies each stored and expanded SHA-256, the dependency graph and the directory commitment with a dependency-free JS SHA-256, assembles an import map of data:text/javascript URLs, caps at 64 MiB and document.write()s the 7,952,983-byte application. The 707,014-byte Module Workbench is a second on-chain document anchored by ModuleWorkbench (services() gives chain/collection/registries) and is recovered by the app or by scripts/modules-recover-workbench.mjs; the 15 MB privacy worker is recovered from ShardedResource and executed as a Blob Worker after matching the edition's pinned hash. No server, no IPFS, no external URL; the dist/ static build exists only for local development. Measured: full recovery of workbench + app in 6,080 ms in Chromium (local provider), 2,275 ms in Node.
wallet_gating: Reading/recovering the app is public ('Reading only. No signature or transaction.'). Access to functionality is gated after the app runs: ConfluenceWallet.connect(collection, tokenId) (web/confluence/wallet.mjs:47-110) first runs assertMintBinding so the page can only be bound to the NFT it was minted for (collection/tokenId/chainId from window.AWE_CHAIN_IDENTITY), then eth_requestAccounts, reads ownerOf(tokenId), accountOf(tokenId) and renderSnapshot at one block and throws 'This wallet does not own the selected NFT.' unless the signer equals ownerOf; the NFT account must have code. assertOwner() (lines 259-281) is re-run before every review: eth_chainId, eth_accounts[0], ownerOf, and account.mode()==0 (proof-authorized 'sovereign' accounts are refused). Each prepare() captures sessionEpoch() and send() re-checks it. The Module Workbench's RegistryAdapter.context() (web/modules/adapter.mjs:11-17) additionally requires the on-chain registry's collection/account/owner to match and account.currentOwner()==ownerOf ('Registry identity or current NFT custody does not match.'), and fresh() re-checks identity+owner+epoch before every send; accountsChanged/chainChanged invalidate the session. On chain, TokenModuleRegistry._authorize requires msg.sender==accountOf(tokenId), artifactIdOfAccount(msg.sender)==tokenId, account.currentOwner()==ownerOf(tokenId), rootOf==expectedRoot and sessionEpoch==expectedEpoch; ChunkedCartridgeRegistry.launchManifest.authorized is player==controller where controller is the parent NFT's current owner. The off-chain worlds server uses a SIWE-style challenge with resource anima:nft:<chainId>:<collection>:<tokenId>:epoch:<sessionEpoch>, verifies personal_sign, and re-resolves owner+epoch on every authenticated request and every 5 s on the SSE stream (401 'NFT ownership changed; sign in again.'). Delegation ('authorised by holder') exists only through the NFT account's session keys / AgentPolicyGuard grants (BoundedOperator checks grant.owner==currentOwner, epoch, mode==0, dataHash); the owner-call UI itself has no delegate path.

pitfalls: Chunk files on disk omit the STOP byte; the deployed runtime is 0x00||chunk and expectedRuntimeCodeHash is keccak256 over that
The directory commitment (manifest.sha256) is NOT the sha of runtime.html (runtimeHtmlSha256); both must be carried
A data: URI page has an opaque origin: no localStorage, possibly no SubtleCrypto — hence the embedded JS SHA-256
Legacy OnchainApp expects 'chunkCount()/readChunk(i)' ABI; directories must preserve this reader ABI or old loaders break
Publishing a release never installs it and grants nothing; a holder's install never gives a module spending authority (host proposals are inert)
An activate() that changes the state head must reference a staged record with parent==expectedStateHead and the current epoch; stale reviews revert (StaleReview)
Transfer of the NFT changes sessionEpoch; every pending review, host session and off-chain world session becomes invalid
The archive factory's CREATE nonce is shared — recheck immediately before each tx and verify the ArchiveCreated receipt
PACKAGE-MANIFEST.json / release numbers in docs drift; re-measure before quoting
Forge test runner requires the real 1.7.1 binary; the npm wrapper is rejected
